title: BifrostPermissionDescriptor
description:
Descriptor for one Bifrost RBAC permission.

Emitted by `gen_schemas` (Stage 3 C7) and returned by the `bifrost.list_permissions` MCP tool.

permission.description:
Operation token in `resource:action` format (e.g. `bifrost_table:read`).

Names the operation only. The object half of the grant is [`Self::scope`]; there is no string spelling for an object.

scope.description: Objects the permission reaches, as the typed RBAC scope.

BifrostPermissionScope.description: The Bifrost objects one grant reaches.

oneOf.description: Every table currently or later resolved beneath one catalog/schema pair.
Exactly one registered table, identified by its stable server-managed UID.

BifrostSchemaScope.description:
One canonical Bifrost catalog and schema pair.

These are the *logical* names a caller writes in SQL — catalog `vala`, schema `logs` — not the flattened internal namespace (`vala.logs`) and not the physical Iceberg catalog name.

catalog.description: Logical catalog, `vala` for every table Bifrost serves today.

schema.description: Logical schema beneath the catalog, such as `logs` or `traces`.

BifrostTableScope.description:
One exact registered Bifrost table.

The UID is the authority: it is assigned at registration and never reused, so a grant does not follow a dropped-and-recreated table of the same name. The catalog and schema ride alongside it so the synchronous checker can evaluate schema containment without a catalog lookup.

catalog.description: Logical catalog the table resolves under.

schema.description: Logical schema the table resolves under.

PermissionScope.description:
Objects one permission grant reaches.

Domain-tagged rather than a shared string object language: a future Wyrd domain that needs object scope adds its own typed variant instead of overloading someone else's identity spelling.

oneOf.description: Every object of the covered resource and action.
